diagnosis: The previous infinite loop was caused by full-checkpoint partial replay repeatedly restoring to ckpt_n_tokens=181 and replaying a one-token draft after zero draft tokens were accepted.
The serial fallback makes progress by clearing the replay draft and forcing one ordinary target decode after checkpoint restore.

ngram-simple draft usefulness is too low for this prompt: only two serial fallbacks were needed, but the extra speculative verification and slightly higher miss counts still leave throughput at 3.7 tok/s.
Because throughput is below 4.2 tok/s, none of the temporary source changes should be promoted.
action: Reject and revert all temporary source changes. Keep this artifact and the plan record only. Current accepted SOTA remains 4.2 tok/s.
